change_policy: Every v1 setting not listed under changes still applies. Any further change requires a new version and a dated explanation before evaluation.
rationale: CRSP removed class-group ids for funds with a single share class (April 2024 release notes). A test on D1b found that about 74% of funds with no group look like single-class funds, so v1 excluded real funds. See reports/2026-11-17-crsp-release-notes-summary.md.
outcome_independence: The decision rests on release notes and on D1b group and portfolio-number fields. No return, outcome or portfolio result was used. Note that v1 baseline outcomes had already been examined (reports/2026-11-16-chronological-baseline.md) before this change.

sample.class_group_rule.v1: classes with no crsp_cl_grp on the latest available summary are excluded as missing_class_group
sample.class_group_rule.v2: classes with no crsp_cl_grp on the latest available summary are treated as single-class funds and identified by crsp_fundno
sample.class_group_rule.applies_to: formation universe, feature history, targets and selected-portfolio weights
sample.class_group_rule.sensitivity: report v1 (exclude ungrouped classes) alongside v2 for every headline count

fund_identity_rule.rule: fund_id = last non-blank crsp_cl_grp known as of the date; if none has been seen, 'S:' + crsp_fundno
fund_identity_rule.carry_forward: A group stays attached after a later blank. Only rows with a single summary record on that date are used.
fund_identity_rule.late_group: If a class gains a group later, its fund id switches at the first date the group is known and its history restarts. Earlier months are not re-assigned to the group.

open_design_points: Ungrouped funds that share a crsp_portno with other classes (about 8% of ungrouped funds) may be genuine gaps rather than single-class funds. Decide whether to flag or exclude them.
Ungrouped funds with no crsp_portno (about 18%) cannot be tested and are treated as single-class under the rule above.
required_before_evaluation: Implement the rule in the panel with tests.
Rebuild the panel and record new code, config and panel hashes in this file.
Rerun the coverage and missing-target counts and compare them with v1.
Report v1 and v2 side by side.
unchanged: All other v1 settings: dates, features, availability lags, target, model, portfolios, costs, inference and freeze conditions.
